description: This file contains function prototypes and PHP extension implementations for the CCSP WebUI component, including functions for parameter get/set, object management, and DBus message handling, primarily for RDK-Broadband platform.

methods.name: getStr
methods.description: Fetches a string parameter value from the data model via CCSP API.

methods.name: setStr
methods.description: Sets a string parameter value in the data model via CCSP API.

methods.name: getInstanceIds
methods.description: Retrieves all instance IDs for a given resource string.

methods.name: addTblObj
methods.description: Adds an object to a table resource string.

methods.name: delTblObj
methods.description: Deletes an object from a table resource string.

methods.name: DmExtGetStrsWithRootObj
methods.description: Gets multiple parameter values under a root object.

methods.name: DmExtSetStrsWithRootObj
methods.description: Sets multiple parameter values under a root object.

methods.name: DmExtGetInstanceIds
methods.description: Retrieves instance IDs under an object table.
